quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on Ace Bailey's selective palate for food
quotes.excerpt: He don't like nothing that he can't like, that he doesn't know.
quotes.quote: We're eating at my crib. I gave him some chicken and shrimp, fried rice, and I had some sauce from my fridge. My chef made some more sauce. He sees the first little bit of sauce, he's like, 'This is nasty' or something. He's like, 'What's the black stuff in it?' It's literally pepper. I'm not eating this, bro. And then I give him the same sauce just freshly made, he's like, 'Oh yeah, I'll try this.' He don't like nothing that he can't like, that he doesn't know. If it ain't from Chattanooga, he don't know it.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr. on Kevin Love's rigid, old-head pregame routine
quotes.excerpt: He's an old-head routine. Like it's so by the minute.
quotes.quote: Watching his routine, he's an old-head routine. Like it's so by the minute. He changes his jersey at halftime, so do I. He changes everything at halftime. He be running sprints pregame. He honestly has the same pregame routine as me.
